ideas.title: The Impact of Childcare Fraud on Families
ideas.description: An investigation into the effects of childcare fraud on families, including financial and emotional impacts.
ideas.angle: Human interest story exploring the consequences of childcare fraud
questions: What are the financial impacts on families?
How does childcare fraud affect families emotionally?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the need for greater oversight and regulation in the childcare industry.

ideas.title: The Rise of Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the recent cases of childcare fraud in Minnesota, including potential connections to larger schemes.
ideas.angle: Investigative story exploring the causes and consequences of childcare fraud in Minnesota
questions: What are the common tactics used by scammers?
How can we prevent similar cases in the future?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal patterns and connections between different cases of childcare fraud.
